title: MCP Marketplace
description: Pick MCP servers from MCPMarket & ModelScope and install them as local configs
degradedTip: ModelScope is temporarily unreachable; showing local preset cards.
partialTip: Installable services are still being verified in the background; showing completed results only. The catalog will refresh automatically.
truncatedTip: Sorting covers only the first {total} results

install.title: Install {name}
install.description: Choose an install variant and confirm to create a local MCP config.
install.noVariants: This server does not publish an auto-installable config. Check the source page for manual setup, or add it manually in MCP config.
install.noVariantsHosted: This is an officially hosted server. Its usable endpoint is generated only after your ModelScope account authorizes it. Sign in on the marketplace page to copy your personal URL, or pick a local install variant, then add it in MCP config.
install.nameConflict: An enabled config with this name exists; rename before installing
install.envTip: These env vars need real values (e.g. API keys) and must be filled before install.
install.localCommandTip: This variant runs a local command (stdio). Make sure you trust the source and publisher of this server.
install.deadVariant: This install endpoint is dead (unreachable or erroring) and cannot be installed
install.checkoutTip: This variant runs scripts inside the repo. The source is cloned automatically into a local working directory on install (git required); install dependencies per the repo instructions.
install.discoverHint: Connect to the server to detect the real tool list; stdio runs the command once locally.
install.confirmTip: Create config and enable AI tool registration
install.runtimeRestart: After installing the runtime, restart gsuid_core and reopen this wizard to re-check.

runtimeGuide.nodejs: This server needs the Node.js runtime. Install Node.js (LTS recommended, ships with npx) from nodejs.org.
runtimeGuide.uv: This server needs the uv runtime. Run pip install uv, or follow the Astral install docs.
runtimeGuide.docker: This server runs as a container. Install and start Docker Desktop / Docker Engine first.
runtimeGuide.python: This server needs the Python runtime. Install Python and make sure it is on the system PATH.
runtimeGuide.pipx: This server needs pipx. Run pip install pipx, then pipx ensurepath.
runtimeGuide.deno: This server needs the Deno runtime. Install Deno and make sure it is on the system PATH.
runtimeGuide.bun: This server needs the Bun runtime. Install Bun and make sure it is on the system PATH.
runtimeGuide.unknown: Make sure {command} is installed on this machine and its executable is on the system PATH.

install.credSharedNotice: The value entered at install is a shared credential: it only powers public tools and tool discovery. Services with credentials default all tools to private — each user binds their own via DM (or install bindings for masters here).
install.credManualHint: Users can self-bind anytime by DMing the bot: mcp绑定 <service> <credential>.
install.uninstallDesc: This deletes the local config "{name}" and all user credential bindings. This cannot be undone.
